title: Top-k Mirror attention Views over one physical cache
hypothesis: Top-k attention over eight structured logical Views can use one canonical K/V cache plus view codes and paid routing indices while exactly matching independent materialized-view attention; active attention compute will scale with k even though cache bytes do not.
mirror_coordinate: eight per-view RoPE-plane rotation codes on keys and values, with per-query selected-view indices
logical_multiplicity: top-k logical attention functions active over one physical cache
controls: native direct phase/rotation coordinate implementation with identical function

development.selection_metric: top-k output relative error, serialized bytes, active MAC proxy, and measured output diversity

success_gate: Across all audit seeds and k values, lazy top-k output relative error <=1e-5 and actual shared payload <=25% of independent payload at k=8. Report compute scaling with k explicitly; no free-compute claim. Native exact alias is FAIL for Mirror-specific attribution.
failure_gate: Any audit error >1e-5 or k=8 payload >25% independent. Exact native rotation alias rejects Mirror-specific value even if shared-cache mechanics pass.
boundaries: Synthetic FP32 attention only; no trained model, language quality, capacity, GPU throughput, or production serving claim.
Logical combinations are not independent capacity; assess only measured task outputs, bytes, and compute.
Routing schedule is deterministic and its selected indices are serialized and charged in both methods.
